en: How do I install the ready-made templates?

steps: Normally automatic when the number connects; an empty Templates screen installs them once, and the button retries after a failure
edgeCases: Existing names are skipped; failures are listed and a bad pack entry is reported, never a 500
A timeout keeps the claim for the sweep
Own number not connected: 404 no_active_number (a store on the shared number sees the platform templates instead, never an empty list)
